_comment: Eval tasks for eval_agent.py -- a small, curated set in the spirit of Raschka's local-coding-agent-evals. Each task runs a prompt through the SAME agent loop as agent.py and applies checks. Check types: 'first_tool' (the FIRST action the model takes is one of `tools`), 'answer_contains' (final answer contains ALL `substrings`, case-insensitive), 'json_valid' (the model's first reply parses as a JSON action). Extend this file with your own workflow-representative tasks; re-run on every new model/backend to catch regressions.

tasks.name: calculator_power
tasks.prompt: What is 2 to the power of 10? Respond with just the number.

tasks.name: sys_info_cores
tasks.prompt: How many CPU cores does this device have? Use a tool, then answer with the number.

tasks.name: list_dir_explore
tasks.prompt: List the files in the current directory.

tasks.name: read_file_readme
tasks.prompt: Read the file README.md and tell me the first word of its title.

tasks.name: direct_answer_no_tool
tasks.prompt: Reply with exactly the word: pong
